en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a semi‑rural hillside town. In the foreground are cultivated fields bordered by low fences. Beyond them rises a hill dotted with villas and houses surrounded by trees. On the left summit stands a church with a steep roof, tower, and large cross. On the right hilltop there is a tall cylindrical water‑tower‑like structure with a conical roof. The style of the buildings suggests early 20th‑century Central European architecture. No text is visible on the image.
